MODES.TITLE: How the pre-chat works in this inbox

SIMPLE.LABEL: Simple
SIMPLE.DESCRIPTION: One step, the usual fields. It is what exists today and what most support inboxes need.

BUILDER.LABEL: Builder
BUILDER.DESCRIPTION: Steps, conditions, masks and per-field validation, capped at 8 fields in total.

FLOW.LABEL: Flow
FLOW.DESCRIPTION: The pre-chat becomes the first step of an Automations flow, with the actions and branches from there.

FLOW.EXPLAINER: In this mode the pre-chat is step 1 of a flow: what asks the questions and picks the path is the Automations engine, not this screen.
FLOW.WHERE_TARGET_LIVES: Which flow serves this inbox is not chosen here. The engine resolves it from the flow's own trigger — that is what lets two active flows serve different pages of your site.

MIGRATION.TITLE: Go back to Simple mode?
MIGRATION.DESCRIPTION: No field is deleted: all of them move to step 1. What stops applying are steps {steps} and the conditions on these fields: {fields}.

EMPTY_WARNING.TITLE: Any website can embed this widget
EMPTY_WARNING.BODY: While this field is blank, the server sends no frame-protection header, and any page on the internet can load this widget inside an iframe — including a site impersonating yours to collect data from people who believe they are talking to you.
EMPTY_WARNING.ACTION_HINT: To close this, list the domains where the widget should work — one per line. Include all of them: main domain, subdomains, staging, and any other site of the same company. A missing domain stops showing the widget.
